pr_title: Fix file selector not allowing choosing files by path
pr_body:
Fixes #2228 
Previously was treating path entered into the file selector either as path to a directory, or as a name of the file in current directory. Now allows also for entering path to the file, both relative and absolute.
pr_comments: Hi @Adrijaned, thanks for your contribution, I'll try to take to this issue ASAP in this week.

issue_context.title: Cannot export file with absolute path on Linux
issue_context.body:
When exporting, if the path is `/tmp/image.png`, the image will be exported at
 `<current directory>/tmp/image.png`, not at `/tmp/image.png`.

IMO, the software should always use `realpath`.

### Aseprite and System version

Same as in #2228.

What is going on?
